scope: Independent local read-only input audit; CPU only; no server, browser, network, simulator or checkpoint deserialization
authorization_context: User requested training after the four-hour B1 design; this file verifies package inputs only

contact_sensor.evaluation_requirement: Resolve four foot indices explicitly and verify current data shape; never treat all robot bodies as feet

historical_reference_agent_evidence.scope: Stored F10 historical effective configuration; does not verify fresh B1 runtime

legacy_evaluator_issues_to_remove: load_checkpoint_actor reconstructs only linear weights and assumes ELU; ignores normalizer state and does not explicitly sort/validate actor layer identities
run_scenario records truncated but ignores it, allowing timeout reset state to contaminate tracking samples
nan_actions are replaced with nan_to_num instead of failing evidence preservation; Infinity is not audited
step_dt is used to derive steps but not checked against the fixed 0.02-second and 1000-step contract
required_execution_checks: Use a fresh package directory; include frozen references and original/candidate reward files with SHA manifest
Verify provided source hashes and snapshot current installed RSL source before candidate application; mismatch prevents training
Verify effective scratch initialization with resume=false, 6144 environments, seed42, 1500 iterations and all ten B1 weights from generated runtime configuration
Verify actor architecture and normalizer against fresh effective agent config/checkpoint; reject unsupported state instead of assuming absence
Assert current environment control step is 0.02 seconds and horizon runs exactly 1000 steps per scenario/reset seed
Account for first terminal and first timeout separately; mask final timeout tick and later reset trajectories; early timeout invalidates protocol
Record raw/clipped action with actual action-manager relationship and explicit foot-contact names
Apply four-hour deadline relative to actual allocation start; independent cleanup/retrieval reserve cannot be replaced by old nominal six-hour runner deadline

implementation_review.review_mode: Read-only independent review; implementation changes made by responsible runner/evaluator agents

initial_findings.problem: Package-relative checkpoint paths were interpreted against training process cwd
initial_findings.resolution: Evaluator normalizes relative checkpoint paths against manifest parent before hash/load; changed-cwd regression test passes

initial_findings.problem: Runner periodically rewrote current source-audit file while evaluator asserted that file SHA was immutable
initial_findings.resolution: Runner creates immutable audit_records/<phase>_<terrain>_source_audit.json for each child; periodic guard writes separate current_source_audit.json

initial_findings.problem: Manifest asserted no normalization/action clipping without validating effective fresh agent settings
initial_findings.resolution: verify_config now validates MLPModel actor/critic hidden dimensions512/256/128,ELU,obs_normalizationfalse,identity empirical normalization,explicit clip_actionsnull and physics0.02; actor normalization state/dimensions/finiteness validated at load

source_level_seed_application.reset: new evaluator invokes env.unwrapped.seed(reset_seed) and torch.manual_seed(reset_seed) before reset

implementation_review.mask_review: Tracks first terminal and timeout separately; excludes event tick and postreset states; final timeout999 is permitted, earlier timeout invalidates fixed1000-step coverage; final concurrent termination remains a fall
implementation_review.deadline_review: Relative deadlines anchored to actual allocation start; monotonic fallback prevents backward wall-clock extension; process cutoff is55s before each phase deadline and process-group cleanup includes SIGINT30s/SIGTERM15s/SIGKILL5s
implementation_review.process_review: Child starts a new process group; cleanup checks group existence even after shell leader exits; next GPU phase requires owned group exit; no automatic retry/resume
implementation_review.archive_review: Critical selected or latest partial checkpoint preserved first; full archive follows; size and SHA receipts emitted; compression/hash reader checks portal shutdown-request deadline
implementation_review.runtime_limits: CPU contracts do not validate Isaac sensor/action APIs, actual environment behavior, loaded actor outputs or remote source equivalence; prescribed live preflight/readback remains necessary

note: No claims about current remote runtime or allocation state are made by this local audit
